headline: Popular posts a record quarter despite a one-off charge-off
summary_short: Popular's Q2 2026 net income rose 13% q/q and 32% y/y to $278M ($4.35 diluted EPS) as net interest income grew 3.5% q/q to $693M and ROTCE improved to 17.02% from 15.46%, though net charge-offs jumped to a 1.05% ratio (0.33% excluding a $71M one-off commercial charge-off).
summary_long: Net interest income rose 3.5% q/q to $693M on higher securities and commercial-loan income; NIM flat at 3.66%. Non-interest income grew 8% to $181M on card fees. Provision for credit losses fell $10M q/q to $66M, even as a $71M one-off commercial charge-off pushed NCOs to 1.05% (0.33% ex-item). Opex rose 3% on profit-sharing and incentive accruals. CET1 rose to 16.08%; the company repurchased $125M of stock, exhausted its $500M buyback authorization, and announced a new $1B authorization plus a dividend hike to $0.90/share. Management raised FY2026 NII growth guidance (8%-9%, from 5%-7%), narrowed the tax-rate outlook lower, and widened NCO guidance. CEO Ferrer will retire August 31, 2026, succeeded by CFO García.
